name: v0.65.0
body:
This release updates qlog to the latest IETF drafts, adds explicit stream credit release, and fixes a number of HTTP/3 and connection migration bugs.

* With `Config.RequireStreamCreditRelease`, completed streams count towards the incoming stream limit until the application calls `ReleaseStreamCredit`: [#5981](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5981), [#5982](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5982)
* qlog: events now follow draft-ietf-quic-qlog-quic-events-14 and draft-ietf-quic-qlog-h3-events-14: [#6120](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6120)

## Breaking Changes

* http3: `HTTPStreamer.HTTPStream` now returns `(*Stream, error)`, and no longer sends an implicit 200 response: [#5988](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5988), [#5994](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5994)

## Notable Fixes

* QUIC v2 key updates now use the correct `quicv2 ku` label: [#5973](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5973)
* Connections using zero-length connection IDs no longer stop receiving packets after version negotiation: [#6129](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6129)
* Switching paths now uses a new connection ID, fixing servers that kept sending to the old address after repeated NAT rebindings: [#6015](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6015)
* Clients now send PATH_RESPONSE on the path the PATH_CHALLENGE was received on: [#5980](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5980)
* `Path.Probe` now succeeds on an already validated path: [#6019](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6019)
* Reordered and retransmitted NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames are now handled correctly: [#6009](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6009), [#6007](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6007)
* DATAGRAM frames no longer starve ACKs, control frames and retransmissions: [#5970](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5970)
* `CancelRead` now unblocks `Read` and `Peek` after receiving RESET_STREAM_AT: [#6022](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6022)
* `TryWriteAll` no longer copies queued data quadratically: [#6042](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6042), [#6043](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6043)
* http3: canceling the first request to a host no longer cancels the shared dial: [#6132](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6132)
* http3: bodies shorter than the announced Content-Length now fail with `io.ErrUnexpectedEOF`: [#5913](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5913)
* http3: Content-Length is no longer added to 204 and 304 responses, and is now sent for requests with `http.NoBody`: [#6032](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6032), [#6029](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6029)
* http3: response writes that fail partway (e.g. on a write deadline) no longer corrupt the stream: [#5993](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5993), [#6002](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6002), [#6001](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6001), [#6003](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6003)
* http3: canceling an Extended CONNECT request now interrupts waiting for SETTINGS: [#6020](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6020)
* qlog fixes:
  * incorrect or missing values for transport parameters, packet numbers, congestion metrics, timers, connection IDs and lengths: [#6050](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6050), [#6054](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6054), [#6059](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6059), [#6060](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6060), [#6074](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6074), [#6077](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6077), [#6091](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6091), [#6023](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6023), [#5969](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5969)
  * stateless resets are logged as remote closures: [#6063](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6063)
  * concurrently recorded events are written in order: [#5956](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5956)
  * traces of connections abandoned after version negotiation are closed: [#6130](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6130)
  * http3: traces no longer close before all events are recorded: [#6090](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6090), [#6083](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6083), [#6041](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6041)

## Notable Changes

* Multiple DATAGRAM frames are now packed into a single packet: [#5961](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5961), [#5960](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5960)
* qlog: new `connection_state_updated` and HTTP/3 `stream_type_set` events, and tuples for path probing and migration: [#6111](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6111), [#6113](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6113), [#5977](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5977), [#5979](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5979)
* qlog: `qlog.RedactIPs` redacts IP addresses and ports: [#5943](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5943)
* qlog: HTTP/3 connections now use `qlog.DefaultConnectionTracer`; `http3/qlog.DefaultConnectionTracer` is removed: [#5966](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5966)
* Reduced allocations during the handshake: [#6096](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6096), [#6093](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6093), [#6098](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6098), [#6097](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6097), [#6095](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/6095)
